profile.description: Security profile: standard, strict or relaxed. Omitted, the host's default profile is used.

mounts.description: Mounts to use instead of the four role volumes. An empty list creates a box with no mounts. Omitted, MiniBox creates workspace, home, tools and cache.

idleTimeoutSec.description: Idle timeout in seconds. 0 disables idle sleep for this box; null inherits the global default (BOX_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SEC). A positive number of seconds, at most 365 days, or null to clear. Omitted, the current value stays.

ttlSec.description: Time to live in seconds. A positive integer, at most 365 days, or null for none. Omitted or null stores no TTL, except for an agent token with a max TTL, which stores that cap. A value above the cap is refused. When the time elapses the box stops, and its container is kept.

tools.description: Catalog tool ids to record on the box spec (version latest). After create, call reconcile_tools (or install_tool) to install them onto the shared tools volume.

parameters.description: Groups the audit events of one client session. 1 to 64 letters, digits, dots, colons, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

name.description: New box name. The container is renamed to prefix-name. The workspace volume is not renamed.

cpus.description: CPU cores, between 0.1 and 64, rounded to two decimals.

memoryMb.description: Memory in MB, an integer between 128 and 262144.

pids.description: Process limit, an integer between 1 and 1000000.

labels.description: User labels stored in the spec. At most 32 entries. Keys follow box name rules. Values are a single line of at most 256 characters. Replaces the current set. Never copied onto the container.

idleTimeoutSec.description: Idle timeout in seconds. 0 disables idle sleep for this box; null inherits the global default (BOX_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SEC). A positive number of seconds, at most 365 days, or null to clear. Omitted, the current value stays.

ttlSec.description: Time to live in seconds. A positive number of seconds, at most 365 days, or null to clear. Omitted, the current value stays.

template.description: Template image: repository[:tag] or a sha256 digest. Omitted, the bundled base template is used.

mounts.description: Mounts that replace the box's mount list. Each entry is { volume, path, mode } with mode rw or ro. Omitted, the current mounts stay. Adding or removing a mount rebuilds the box. A recorded volume can be mounted by several boxes unless another box owns it. A new or changed mount needs volume:attach on its volume, and a read-write one also needs volume:write. A name that does not exist yet creates a standalone volume, which needs volume:write. Refused: minibox-data, volumes without the MiniBox label, internal helper volumes, pool roots, volumes another box owns, and names that start with the label prefix followed by -ws- or -pool-.

env.description: Environment entries that replace the box's env list. Each entry is { name, value? , secretRef? } and needs a value or a secretRef. secretRef is stored and not injected yet. Omitted, the current env stays. Values are not written to container labels.

network.description: Docker network the rebuilt container joins: the host's box network (created when missing) or the network the box already uses. Host, none and container networks, and any other network, are refused.

profile.description: Security profile: standard, strict or relaxed. Omitted, the host's default profile is used.

cmd.description: Shell command, run as /bin/sh -c. Mutually exclusive with argv.

argv.description: Program and arguments, executed directly with no shell. Mutually exclusive with cmd.

env.description: Environment variables for the command, by name. Values are not written to the audit log. Defaults to none.

timeoutSec.description: Stop the process tree after this many seconds. Defaults to 30. Foreground calls accept at most 55; use background for longer commands.

stdin.description: Bytes written to the command's stdin, then closed. Not written to the audit log.

user.description: Container user, as a name or id, optionally with a group. Defaults to dev. The strict profile allows only dev or 1000. Other profiles may use root, and those runs are marked privileged in the audit.

background.description: Return immediately with execId. Poll with exec_get. Defaults to false. A foreground call may use a timeoutSec of at most 55.
